test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A and B together can complete a railway sleeper alignment in 10 days. B alone can do it in 15 days.

In how many days can A alone complete the work?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Days for A alone = (Product of times) ÷ (Difference of times)

Days = (10 × 15) ÷ (15 − 10)

Days = 150 ÷ 5 = 30 days

**∴ Answer = 30**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by (A + B) = 10 days

Time taken by B alone = 15 days

**Formula used:**

Total Work = LCM of individual times

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

 
 
• 
 
• 
 Total Work (LCM) = 30 Units
 10 U
 10 U
 10 U
 (A+B) Eff = 30 ÷ 10 = 3 units/day
 B Eff = 30 ÷ 15 = 2 units/day
 A Eff = 3 − 2 = 1 unit/day

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Total Work = LCM(10, 15) = 30 units

⇒ Efficiency of (A + B) = 30 ÷ 10 = 3 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of B = 30 ÷ 15 = 2 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of A = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of B

⇒ Efficiency of A = 3 − 2 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Time taken by A alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of A

⇒ Time taken by A alone = 30 ÷ 1 = 30 days

**∴ The correct answer is (3).**</p
